description: This file is a C++ source code for a test client interacting with a Thunder-based JSON-RPC service for the StateObserver module. It provides a menu-driven interface to invoke various methods such as getValues, registerListeners, unregisterListeners, getName, getApiVersionNumber, and setApiVersionNumber on the remote module.

methods.name: showMenu
methods.description: Displays a menu of options for the user to select actions to perform on the remote StateObserver module.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that initializes the remote object connection and manages user interaction to invoke different JSON-RPC methods on the StateObserver module.
